name: Sello speaks Sign Language
shortDescription: Sello is Deaf and uses Sign Language to communicate with her sister, family and people around her.
longDescription: Through an ordinary day at home, on the road and at the shops, Sello and her sister show how Sign Language helps them greet, learn, work together and stay safe. When someone does not understand Sign Language, Sello finds another way to communicate.
